description: Na₃GeCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.62 Å. Ge is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.39 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂GeP tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Ge, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂GeP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one P atom.
